This topic is part of the AQA GCSE Geography specification.

Urban Issues & Challenges appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Urban Issues & Challenges in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Urban Issues & Challenges.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
